confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Sydney prices for July 2026; not checked against live menus, listings, or booking pages. Cafe, beer, and restaurant anchors are the most reliable; accommodation is least certain because rates vary widely by suburb and by school-holiday and event demand. Cocktail and wine_glass are direct estimates, not beer-derived. The FX value came from search summaries of RBA pages, not a direct read of the F11.1 table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Oceania basis, anchored to Sydney's general price level as a high-cost Australian capital and reasoned against other large Australian capitals such as Melbourne. No external price data was used for the city anchors.
